title: Corrective fix for B-913ce23b: Review spec 0003 implementation
description:
Blocked reason: FINDING 1 (medium — violates AC "No security anti-patterns around security-scoped URL handling"): RecipesFolderStore.resolveBookmark() calls startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() on line 41 but never calls the matching stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource(). There is no deinit on RecipesFolderStore to balance this. Each call to RecipeDiscovery.scan() therefore executes two start calls against one stop, permanently leaking one reference count per app session. Fix: remove line 41 (`_ = url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()`) from resolveBookmark() — RecipeDiscovery.scan() is the correct place for start/stop per read, and it already does this correctly.

Remaining work: Corrective bead needed: remove the orphaned startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() call from RecipesFolderStore.resolveBookmark(). The call on line 41 of RecipesFolderStore.swift starts security-scoped access but is never balanced by a stop — RecipeDiscovery.scan() already handles start/stop correctly per read, so this call is both redundant and leaking a reference count.

Update tests/docs as needed for the corrective change.
Leave a handoff summary that states how the parent bead can be retried.

handoff_summary.risks: None. The change is a pure deletion of a redundant, incorrect call. `saveBookmark()` retains its own balanced start/stop, which is correct. `RecipeDiscovery.scan()` handles access per read, which is also correct and untouched.

handoff_summary.design_decisions: Removed the call entirely rather than adding a matching stop, because resolveBookmark() is not the right place to hold long-lived security-scoped access. Access should be acquired and released per-read in RecipeDiscovery.scan(), which already does this correctly.

conflict_risks: No conflict risk. Only RecipesFolderStore.swift was modified (single-line removal). No overlap with other in-progress beads.
